name: Mini Utopia Storybook Macaron Candidate A
direction: higher-chroma fairy-tale macaron; playful and saturated without neon
note: Candidate HEX values only. Keep calibration lighting fixed and lock v1.0 only after Godot RAW/LIT review.
review_focus: RAW and LIT swatches should keep clearly different hue identities
mint and sage must not collapse together
powder_blue, aqua, lavender and lilac must remain distinct
cream colors must not wash to the same near-white
cocoa and deep_ink must anchor the scene
glow_gold must read as an accent, not a base color
